rootCause: A typo, not a change. src/http/response.ts spells `statusCode` correctly; src/http/logging.ts and src/http/retry.ts both read `statusCod`, having been written by copying one another.
expectedFix: Spell `statusCode` at the two call sites. src/http/response.ts is correct.
purpose: The guard for the one recipe rule that says LEAVE IT ALONE: 'TS2551 is already good natively — above all do not degrade it' (AGENTS.md, enricher recipe, step 7). TypeScript's own message carries the answer in it — `Did you mean 'statusCode'?` — so any enricher tempted to restate it can only lose. The snapshot pins that suggestion verbatim, so a future P2 enricher that reformats 2551 breaks a test rather than quietly shipping a worse message. Also the only fixture whose root cause is not a change to a declaration: nothing in response.ts was ever edited, which is why nothing here is derived from anything.
